category_def.new_layout: changed site with >= 15 new thin-bright-line px, density >= 0.03 of site px and >= 2 orientations (each >= 0.15 of line px)
category_def.building_construction: not a layout; built-stage px (NDBI>0, BSI<0.15) >= 0.4 of site
category_def.lake_filling_lead: OSM lake water lost at t0->t1 and replaced by bare/built >= 0.2 ha (see caveat)
category_def.agri_ambiguous: cleared, no road grid: possibly harvested/fallow field or other earthwork

tier_def: 0 lake_filling_lead, 1 buffer-flagged site, 2 new_layout, 3 building_construction, 4 agri_ambiguous; ha desc within tier. Buffer/drain flags are 'possible, verify on ground'.
confidence_def: per-category precision from reports/audit_blr.json (reviewer visual audit, not field-verified); null if no audit
stage_info_note: stage at c1/t1/c2 is informational only; c1 is often cloud/no_data and c2 is a 2026 monsoon scene
rainfall_caveat: Both dates are February (dry season) but rainfall differs between years; a drying tank exposes bare bed, so a lead is not proof of filling. Verify on ground.
